shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package-lock.json | head -20 && node -v && npm -v && git log --oneline | head

npm install next@latest react@latest react-dom@latest && npm install -D typescript @types/node @types/react @types/react-dom 2>&1 | tail -5 && node -e "console.log(require('next/package.json').version)"
node -e "const p=require('./package.json'); for (const k of ['@types/node','@types/react','@types/react-dom','typescript','react','react-dom']) console.log(k, require(k+'/package.json').version)"
rm -rf data && (npx next start -p 3123 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) && sleep 4 && curl -s http://localhost:3123/ | grep -oE "Nothing on the go right now|No finished books yet|Add a book"
curl -s http://localhost:3123/ | grep -oE '\$ACTION_ID_[0-9a-f]+' | sort -u; which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules | grep -i playwright
curl -s http://localhost:3123/ | grep -oE '"id":"[0-9a-f]{40,}"' | sort -u; curl -s http://localhost:3123/ | grep -oE 'name="\$ACTION[^"]*"[^>]*value="[^"]*"' | head

pkill -f "next start" ; sleep 1; (npx next start -p 3123 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) && sleep 4 && curl -s http://localhost:3123/books/6bda3e6a-2cbb-4e10-a651-dfb4bc879679 | grep -oE "The Left Hand of Darkness|Updated after finishing|badge finished" | sort -u; pkill -f "next start"; rm -rf data .next; git status --short

npx next build >/dev/null 2>&1 && (npx next start -p 3123 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 4; curl -s http://localhost:3123/books/6bda3e6a-2cbb-4e10-a651-dfb4bc879679 | grep -oE "The Left Hand of Darkness|Updated after finishing|badge finished" | sort -u
kill $(pgrep -f "next-server|next start" | grep -v $$) 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; rm -rf data .next /tmp/flow.mjs; git status --short
